run_upload_diff: run upload.py to upload diffs from git, mercurial, or subversion to the codereview app
run_guess_vcs: run GuessVCS to detect which version control system is being used in the current directory
run_split_patch: run SplitPatch to split a unified diff into separate pieces for each file
run_encode_multipart: run EncodeMultipartFormData to encode form fields and files for multipart/form-data upload
run_get_base_files: run GetBaseFiles to retrieve the base version of files from a diff output
